pages.title: 1. WHAT IS A BOND
pages.explainHtml:
债券 = 借款人给你的 I.O.U.（欠条）：承诺定期付票息（coupon），到期还本金（principal / face / par）。

现金流时间线：前 N−1 期收票息 C；最后一期收 C + 面值 F。美国公司债常见每半年付一次息。

CF_t = C (t < N); CF_N = C + F
易错点：「固定收益」≠ 零风险：票息合同可固定，但市价、通胀、违约、汇率仍会变。

pages.excerpt:
1. What Is A Bond
What is a bond?
A bond = an "I.O.U." from a borrower to you (the investor)
• The borrower promises:
    – Regular Interest Payments → coupon payments
        • Usually paid every 6 months.
    – Return of Your Original Money → principal or “face value”
        • Paid back on the maturity date (the end), usually $1000 per bond.

The payment structure
  Time (t)        1             2                     3    ...       N
Cash Flow         𝐶1           𝐶2                     𝐶3   …       𝐶𝑁 + 𝐹
    – 𝑪𝒕 = coupon payment each period
    – 𝑭 = face value (principal), repaid at maturity (time N)

pages.title: Basic Components of a Bond
pages.explainHtml:
四大零件：Par Value（面值）、Coupon Rate（年票息率）、Maturity（到期）、Payment Frequency（付息频率）。

每期票息 ≈（票息率 × 面值）/ 年付息次数。美国常见面值 $1,000；中国国债常见面值 ¥100。

易错点：票息率是合同写死的；收益率（yield）是按现价算出来的——两者只有在平价时才常相等。

pages.title: 2. SECTORS OF BOND MARKET
pages.explainHtml:
Sector = 按发行人/担保类型划分的市场板块。美国常见：Treasury、Agency、Municipal、Corporate、ABS/MBS、外国债/欧洲债等。

中国常见：国债、政策性银行债、公司债/企业债、商行债、ABS、熊猫债等。监管架构也不同：美国相对「机构分工」，中国更多「按品种分管」。

看监管是为了理解：谁批准发行、谁管交易场所、违约时谁介入——这会影响流动性与信息透明度。

pages.title: 3. Key Bond 3.1. Special Coupon Structure
pages.explainHtml:
票息结构可以很花：固定、浮动（挂钩 SOFR/LPR 等）、零息、step-up、延期付息、PIK（用新债抵利息）等。

结构一变，利率风险与再投资风险的分配就会变——后面定价与收益率模块会反复用到。

pages.title: 4. KEY RISKS OF BOND
pages.explainHtml:
债券风险可粗分为两类：①市场/宏观（利率、通胀、汇率、曲线形态、波动）；②发行人/结构（信用违约、赎回、流动性、事件、税制变化）。

直觉：期限越长、票息越低，价格对利率越敏感；信用越差，利差补偿通常越高。

pages.excerpt:
5. Bond Identification & Quoting

Naming Convention

E.g.: in swift
                   Coca-Cola 4.25s 5/15/2029
Means: 4.25% coupon, matures May 15, 2029

Translation: A Coca-Cola bond that pays 4.25% interest and matures on May
15, 2029.

Note: the notation does not tell the payment frequency, yet most of the US
corporate bonds are paid semiannually

pages.excerpt:
5. Bond Identification & Quoting

CUSIP: the bond’s ID number (U.S. & Canada)
•9-character identifier (U.S. securities):
•Used for: Clearing, trading, and tracking bonds in the U.S. and Canada.
    •1–6: issuer, e.g. 191216 = Coca-Cola
    •7–8: issue (which specific bond), e.g. AC = this version
    •9: check digit (verifies the code is correct).

CINS: for bonds outside the U.S. and Canada (international version of CUSIP)
• 12 characters (instead of 9)
• Starts with a country code (e.g. J for Japan)
• Example: U12345678901 → A bond from the UK.

pages.title: Summary & Key Takeaways
pages.explainHtml:
总结页请当成考前速查卡：能用自己的话复述每一条，才算真懂。

对照左边要点，问自己：对应公式是什么？适用假设是什么？常见反例是什么？
pages.excerpt:
Summary & Key Takeaways

• Bond = Loan contract with fixed payments + return of
  principal.
• Key parts: Par Value, Coupon Rate, Maturity, Payment
  Frequency.
• Market split into sectors: Treasury, Corporate, Municipal,
  ABS/MBS, etc.
• Bonds can include embedded options (call, put, convert) and
  variable coupon structures.
• Core risks: Interest rate, credit, reinvestment, inflation,
  liquidity, and etc.
• Bottom line: Understand structure and risks to invest wisely
